scope: Source GO for root to perform the exact bounded descriptive TRAIN/DEV audit. This review did not execute the real aggregate or open corpus exports, teachers, reserved data or evaluation references.

independent_cpu_execution.data: Authored temporary fixtures only. The deliberately forbidden reference fixture is rejected before read/hash. No actual aggregate, model, framework or engine call.

checks.file_scope: Exact implementation/dependency hashes are checked. Manifest path must resolve to corpus_root/manifest.json; each content path must resolve to corpus_root/train.jsonl or development.jsonl before stat/hash/read. Each export is capped at 8 MiB and compared with exact manifest SHA and declared 1536/96 rows. No reference, teacher, reserve or historical source content is used.
checks.target_semantics: Strict schema/modes/case identity and six-field valid nonterminal FEN; exactly one complete native BEST_MOVE atom must parse to a legal move, and supplied modes must match selected_uci. The original mover, legal check/capture/mate/double-check, promotion, castling and en-passant facts are computed by python-chess. Quiet means only noncapture and noncheck.
checks.grains: A root contributes once only if it has exactly the three distinct modes and one normalized full FEN. Presentation profiles use valid individual rows; selected profiles use selected_a/b. Root target-piece presence uses a set per complete group, explicitly multi-label. Invalid, duplicate, missing, extra and incomplete groups remain separately counted; they are not relabeled to meet quotas.
checks.denominators: Requested split denominators remain 1536 and 96. Move-profile rates use actual valid presentations for that mode; root distributions use complete groups. Empty rates are null, not zero. Duplicate excess, affected and key counts are separately defined. Coverage values are descriptive rather than acceptance outcomes.
checks.material_and_king: Material totals use both sides and fixed P1/N3/B3/R5/Q9/K0 values. Nonpawn bands are numeric 0..13/14..38/39+, not inferred strategic phases. Legal king-move availability counts legal moves from a king and therefore includes castling, as disclosed. Target king checks remain a distinct presentation count.
checks.overlap: Group IDs, case IDs, normalized current-state first four FEN fields, full six-field FEN and native.input_packet-normalized JSON are separate sets/denominators. Exact normalized packet hashes include empty history and supplied selected move. First-four overlap is not described as full input leakage. State/full-FEN root sets use complete groups; packet sets use valid presentations, which is explicit in implementation.
checks.privacy: Serialized aggregate contains counts/rates, categories, line numbers for errors, file paths/hashes and group digests. Internal raw IDs/FENs/targets/move coordinates are not emitted as corpus rows. Malformed row details are reduced to line and exception type.
checks.bounds_and_retention: Create-only output attempt and initial requested counts precede the main verification try. Failures retain a failed result and finally elapsed time. Per-line callbacks enforce the same hardcoded 30 s cap and protocol 13:00 UTC cutoff; no rewriting, resampling or learning exists.
checks.software_tests: Independent 15-test rerun passed. Meaningful coverage includes root vs presentation weights, black POV, en passant/promotion/castling, material and king availability, schemas/missing/duplicates, first4 vs full6/packet distinctions, illegal targets, failure retention, empty denominators and forbidden reference path rejection.

limitations: Ordinary json.loads does not reject duplicate object keys. This review relies on the exact known-producer export hashes and prior corpus coherence audit; it does not claim generic JSON ambiguity detection.
Actual descriptive counts remain unknown until root executes the frozen plan. This is not a completed real-data result.
A completed audit means the descriptive process completed; rows or group anomalies remain explicit findings rather than being converted into a corpus-validity badge.
Only TRAIN versus DEV coverage/overlaps are measured. Historical/reserved/fresh-evaluation comparisons and teacher/prose/PV quality are outside this script.
Move profiles are presentation-weighted while root material and mover-presence profiles are group-weighted. Their denominators must remain visible when reporting later results.
File size/deadline controls bound this local audit but are not a general hostile-input sandbox; the exact frozen plan and trusted pinned local exports are the authorized scope.
No model-quality inference, representativeness claim, new training, cohort reselection or evaluation opening is authorized by this GO.
